Subject: Introducing Smart Assess Ja to Camperdown High School
Body:
Dear Mr. Valentine Bailey,

My name is Steven Gordon, and I'm the founder of Smart Assess Ja, a Jamaica-built digital education and assessment platform designed to help schools move beyond paper-based teaching, learning, and examinations.

I saw that Camperdown High School has already been investing in classroom technology (new tech/coding learning centre unveiled June 2025), which tells me your team already thinks about this the way we do.

Smart Assess Ja is more than an examination platform — it's an all-in-one learning environment that supports the entire student journey, from everyday classwork and homework through to study sessions, quizzes, and formal exams. A quick look at what it offers:

For Teachers — build and assign homework, classwork, quizzes, and exams from one place, draw from a shared question bank with AI-assisted question generation, track class performance, and generate report cards automatically.

For Students — one place for homework, classwork, quizzes, and exams instead of juggling paper and different apps, plus self-paced mock exams to practise independently and a personal progress tracker.

For Schools — centralized timetabling, report cards, and messaging school-wide, real exam-integrity tooling built in (fullscreen lock, tab-switch detection, single-device login) rather than bolted on, and pricing built specifically for the Jamaican market — starting at US$10.00 per student per year, well below international tools priced around US$25.

I'd like to offer Camperdown High School a no-cost pilot period, formalized with a simple, non-binding letter of intent, so your team can try the platform on a real assessment cycle before any commitment is made. You're welcome to see it yourself first — there's a public demo exam at smartassessja.com/demo-exam that takes about two minutes, no account needed.

If this is something Camperdown High School would be interested in exploring, I would be happy to arrange a short demonstration at a convenient time for your team.

Kind regards,
Steven Gordon
Founder, Smart Assess Ja
